bottino-method-base.title: Bottino Method — Foundation Course
bottino-method-base.description: Eight learning units on distinguishing facts from interpretations, checking sources and critically evaluating AI responses.

scrittura-investigativa-documentale.title: Investigative Writing and Reconstruction of Real Events
scrittura-investigativa-documentale.description: A course for writers of true stories: documentary reconstruction, evidence assessment and writing fact-based articles, investigations and books.

storie-che-mancano.title: The Missing Stories
storie-che-mancano.description: Turn photographs and incomplete records into the story of a forgotten life.

archivio-vivo.title: When Archives Become Stories
archivio-vivo.description: Organise letters, photographs and objects into an accessible narrative project.

voci-da-salvare.title: Voices Worth Saving
voci-da-salvare.description: Interview, transcribe and present testimonies while respecting informed consent.

atlante-delle-storie.title: Atlas of Stories
atlante-delle-storie.description: Tell the story of a neighbourhood or town through maps, images and memories.

scrivere-i-vuoti.title: Writing the Gaps
scrivere-i-vuoti.description: Write true stories when sources are silent or contradictory, without inventing evidence.

dossier-in-libro.title: From Dossier to Book
dossier-in-libro.description: Turn collected research materials into a readable publishing project with notes and supporting documentation.

fotografie-senza-nome.title: Unnamed Photographs
fotografie-senza-nome.description: Investigate anonymous photographs without assigning unproven names or dates: visual clues, provenance, context and uncertainty records.

cronologie-impossibili.title: Impossible Timelines
cronologie-impossibili.description: Tell a true story when dates, recollections and documents disagree, building a timeline that also presents alternatives.

museo-in-una-stanza.title: A Museum in One Room
museo-in-una-stanza.description: Design an accessible small-scale narrative exhibition using a few objects, images and community testimonies.

lettere-oltre-la-grafia.title: Letters Beyond Handwriting
lettere-oltre-la-grafia.description: Transcribe, translate and annotate difficult family letters while separating text, hypotheses and AI errors.

albero-che-racconta.title: The Family Tree That Tells a Story
albero-che-racconta.description: Turn complex family trees into a readable, documented and updateable book.

voci-senza-registratore.title: Voices Without a Recorder
voci-senza-registratore.description: Recover fragmentary oral memories from notes, letters and indirect accounts without inventing unrecorded quotations.
